displayImportantNote: 15/10/2026 (v9 and v10 measures, 21/34 both): every phone view missed display.fontSize, the slide title (h1.slide-title) 27px where the slot writes the system's capped phone size, 33-34px (55-86px on a desktop; 1.25 of the template's own 27px, DISPLAY_OVER_TEMPLATE). The slot's rule was there and lost: the release's css/template.css sets `h1, .h1 { font-size: 1.8rem !important }` up to 575.98px (1.8 x its 15px root = 27px), and a plain rule never beats an !important one, whatever its weight. The line height of the slot's own rule reached the title (29.7px = 1.1 x 27 under Moxie), which is how the plain size was seen to lose. displayImportant writes the display size !important, desktop and phone (the line height and letter spacing stay plain, so the Vietnamese line height still wins); from 576 to 639px and on a desktop the template's sizes were plain and the slot's already won, so nothing changes there
